mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a deepening labor market crisis that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's expected policy tightening increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized growth signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong labor market expansion (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month), corporate hiring increases consumer spending and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates rising consumer confidence and economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
